India wrap up the group stage unbeaten!
A dominant 45-24 win over Sri Lanka sees India finish the group stage with six wins in six matches at the Commonwealth Kabaddi Championship 2026!
Pankaj Mohite led the raiding charge with 15 raid points, followed by Aditya Shinde with 10. Nitesh (5) and Yogesh Dahiya (4) made their presence felt in defence as India continued their winning run in style!
